shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright slab-like stone monument
incised linear signs or symbols on the surface
registers or horizontal divisions of the surface
justification: Both are upright monuments bearing shallow relief with anthropomorphic content, symbolic signs and a disc-like element, but A shows a narrative scene of two seated figures in profile facing each other across an offering table above horizontal lines of script, while B is a single frontal, sculpted-in-the-round figure with an elaborate headdress and chest ornaments and no narrative scene or text bands. The correspondences (a human figure, some incised marks, a circle) are of the most generic kind and give no sign of a shared iconographic scheme.
